results.title: The Days of Poncho
results.overview: Poncho raps on the streets until his father finds out he quit school and forces him to work delivering gas tanks. Between music, work, and tension with his dad, Poncho faces the weight of growing up.

results.title: Getar Hero
results.overview: A down-on-his-luck cowboy roams Bombay's neon night in this lyrical, urban Western.

results.title: Ruckus
results.overview: Tobias likes his downstairs neighbour Elss. After he sees her reaction to a party next door he starts causing a ruckus to get her attention.

results.title: The Last Movie Critic
results.overview: The Last Movie Critic is a documentary portrait of Roger Ebert, not just the critic, but the idea he became. Through the voices of the filmmakers he championed and the words he left behind, the film explores how one man’s deep and abiding love for cinema became a gift to everyone who ever sat in the dark and felt something. A celebration of movies, of empathy, and of the belief that what we watch together can make us more human.

results.title: Hennie's Theme Park
results.overview: The maverick entrepreneur and multi-millionaire Hennie van der Most built a business empire from scratch. Now we follow him as he works on what is set to be his final project: creating a large-scale theme park on Rotterdam's Maashaven.

results.title: Call of the She-Demon: Modest Male Exposure 3
results.original_title: Call of the She-Demon: Modest Male Exposure 3
results.overview: Sam is managing an Adult Erotic Club while the owner Mistress Windy  is on an extended vacation. But he is failing to get women to attend the club and male customers are complaining. Sam's friend Goldie finds a tucked-away spell-book and discovers that Windy would practice Witchcraft. In a desperate attempt to balance the male-female attendance ratio, they perform a demon-invoking ritual. But things spiral out of control as unexpected lust and chaos are summoned into the space.

results.title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 9
results.overview: The ninth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on July 31, 2026, at Takamatsu City Gymnasium in Takamatsu, Kagawa, Japan, and was headlined by a B Block match between Yuya Uemura and Aaron Wolf.

results.title: The Dead Keep Dying
results.overview: A drifter plagued with fatal premonitions gets pulled into a world of violence, incest and intrigue after befriending a down-on-his-luck taxi driver.

results.title: Az Zeeb
results.overview: The filmmaker, a Chilean of Jewish and Palestinian descent, discovers Super 8 reels belonging to his father’s family. Between Chile, Israel and Palestine, he reconstructs two trajectories shaped by displacement and exile. A lesson in history in which clarity emerges from political complexity.

results.title: Hansel & Gretel's Halloween
results.overview: On Halloween night, six teens enter a candy-coated labyrinth from the tale of Hansel and Gretel, where a deadly Witch turns temptation into traps-and resisting the sweetest lure is their only way out.

results.title: Pretty Ugly: The Story of the Lunachicks
results.original_title: Pretty Ugly: The Story of the Lunachicks
results.overview: Punk music icons, Lunachicks, reunite after 20 years in an unfiltered, hilarious, and electric documentary. Packed with rare archival footage, the film traces their rise from gritty NYC teens to feminist trailblazers of the 90s grunge era. Fans and newcomers alike will thrill as the band recounts old antics, rekindles bonds, and embarks on their long-awaited journey back to the stage.

results.title: Paradise
results.overview: The enigmatic captain of a burning cargo ship binds together the fates of two families; one in a bustling Ghanaian city, the other in a quiet Canadian town.

results.title: Yellow Slum
results.overview: Raised in the favelas of Rio de Janeiro, Damião joins a local drug gang to help pay for college. During a night shift, he spots hooded figures sneaking through the forest toward a church, uncovering an NGO tied to powerful politicians hiding rituals devoted to the King in Yellow.

results.title: Maid Robot
results.overview: A robot developer is threatened by the competition when his maid robots deem to be too powerful and human.

results.title: Hell of H.R.
results.overview: In the Human Resources conglomerate of Hell, where employees eternally toil in perpetual justice, veteran employee Ruth Honda faces an unprecedented dilemma: a convict appeals his sentence, claiming innocence. While attempting to resolve the case, Ruth and her colleagues find themselves trapped in a labyrinth of absurd procedures and eccentric figures, exposing the ironies and contradictions of a hellish work system.

results.title: Y
results.overview: Olga's grandmother, a successful lawyer, reveals on her deathbed that the adoptions she handled in the wake of the Romanian Revolution are riddled with shortcomings and the fate of many children unknown. Olga sets out to dig up the past.

results.title: The Serpent Pace
results.overview: The Serpent Pace is an autobiographical documentary that follows filmmaker Estêvão Ciavatta Pantoja’s journey of regeneration after a fall from a horse left him tetraplegic. The film uses his personal experience as a starting point to explore how one can transform suffering into a virtuous process of reconnecting with life.
